title: Saw lots of Star Wars: Galactic Racer Gameplay videos and decided to build one of my own
author: hyp3rclaw
selftext: actual gameplay not sped up , would you guys play this ?  not adding any links since it removes the post! dm if anyone wants to try it out its on web/threejs - supports mobile,desktop,console

replies.author: Zerophonic
replies.body: Making AI games is one thing, but using AI generated music is just sad. Why not ask some hobby artists if they want to feature a track on the game?

replies.author: hyp3rclaw
replies.body:
ill do that once game takes up shape, its just a prototype that i put together in couple of hours!  
if it pickups up ill sit with fl and make some beats or reachout to someone who wants to work on this with me!

replies.author: Zerophonic
replies.body: Sounds good, good luck with the project. I might be able to supply a track for fun (I'm a hobbyist dnb producer).

replies.author: hyp3rclaw
replies.body: SEND IT ! ill plug it in asap , dm's open

replies.author: Wooden_Plant7504
replies.body: Would you be able to share a bit about your high level workflow (Claude vs Codex, tools used, high level process)?

replies.author: hyp3rclaw
replies.body:
Claude Opus 5.5(Medium), generate lots of reference images via gpt images , for assets use blender mcp via claude with reference images and let it cook!  
gameplay is something that you manually need to playtest and tweak , otherwise its bit too generic , so keep iterating from there

replies.author: hyp3rclaw
replies.body: feel free to dm if you need more info/help , happy to help

comments.author: gamerqc
comments.body: I'd add a cooldown for shooting or it becomes de facto the best way to play. Maybe even add powerups like Mario Kart / Rollcage so you can activate a Shield, Lasers, Homing Missiles, etc.

replies.author: hyp3rclaw
replies.body: it has a cooldown, also if you boost too much drone heats up and blasts lol, also has shields + mines , ill add rollcage that would be cool

replies.author: hyp3rclaw
replies.body:
Yes I'm aware , im not going to sit and write each and every line of code , i wanted to build similar game and i prompted , it built out a super basic version with blocks on which I iterated on for hours with different artstyle, gameplay , asserts , mechanics, sfx until it felt right 

I've been a game dev for 6+ years, using ai to prototype ideas faster is not bad , please get out of this mindset, hope it helps
